requirement_body_patches.REQ-KEYBOARD-NAV-001: The documented host uses native macOS/Windows accessibility facilities and offers high contrast. Support is partial: browser tags/filters, MPE editing, Max and some plug-ins are not supported; Wavetable matrix and advanced Operator controls are not fully optimized. This is a documented limitation, not permission to remove those features or proof of exact-build accessibility. The chapter also lists audio-clip fade editing as not currently supported for screen readers. These remain publication-scope limitations, not a target-build exclusion or successful unsupported-operation test.
requirement_body_patches.REQ-KEYBOARD-NAV-002: With Use Tab Key to Move Focus enabled, Tab/Shift-Tab move next/previous control. With it off, Tab switches Session/Arrangement. Text editors, plug-in windows and modal interception require their own applicability evidence. The documented setting is exposed through Navigate and Display & Input Settings; actual focus/interception outside an independently admitted main-window context remains U.
requirement_body_patches.REQ-KEYBOARD-NAV-003: Wrap Tab Navigation enabled cycles last-to-first and first-to-last within an area. Ctrl-Tab/Ctrl-Shift-Tab on Windows or Option-Tab/Option-Shift-Tab on Mac move next/previous mixer control in the same row. Exact focus order for every view remains U. Wrap Tab Navigation is offered through Navigate and Display & Input Settings. The source stopping contrast does not define every off-mode boundary or focus area.
requirement_body_patches.REQ-KEYBOARD-NAV-008: Options Accessibility includes Speak Menu Commands, Speak Minimum and Maximum Slider Values and Speak Time in Seconds. Info/help descriptions depend on screen-reader help-text settings; macOS uses VoiceOver verbosity or VO-Shift-H. Announcement content/order/timing, protocol trees and device coverage are U. The source gives Alt+O on Windows and VO+M then O with macOS VoiceOver for the Options/Accessibility entry. These are platform-specific source roles, not a new generic reader-modifier encoding or guarantee for every reader.
requirement_body_patches.REQ-KEYBOARD-NAV-009: Alt on Windows or Option on Mac plus0..7 focuses Control Bar, Session, Arrangement, Clip editor, Device, Browser, Groove Pool, Learn respectively. Control Bar restores its last-focused control on return. Other-view restoration, hidden-area behavior and modifier/layout collisions remain U. The source gives Alt+N on Windows and VO+M then N with macOS VoiceOver to open Navigate. Main-view focus chords do not prove menu traversal, hidden-view creation or all-focus dispatch.
requirement_body_patches.REQ-KEYBOARD-NAV-012: First opening an audio clip selects Sample Editor and MIDI clip selects MIDI Note Editor. Alt/Option3 focuses active editor; Alt/Option-Shift-P focuses clip panels. Documented note/marker key commands dispatch to MIDI/Warp owners; no editor codec or DSP is inferred. With an independently admitted clip and known closed Clip View entry context, the source offers double-click from Session/Arrangement or Ctrl+Alt+3 on Windows/Cmd+Option+3 on Mac to open Clip View. The shortcut table calls that chord Hide/Show Clip View; already-visible/toggle/focus histories remain U rather than an unconditional always-open law.
requirement_body_patches.REQ-KEYBOARD-NAV-014: From focused search, Tab reaches filter-view toggle, filter menu, then sidebar; from sidebar Tab reaches shown filters or content pane. Down from search reaches content. Sidebar up/down changes label, left/right move sidebar/content, content right/left expand/collapse folders, Shift-up/down extends selection. Browser search/preview outcomes remain owned by browser workflows; tagging/filter accessibility stays unsupported in source. Browser Workflows004 owns Ctrl+F/Cmd+F search focus with All selection. Browser Content046 owns an eligible selected item preview request via right arrow even while Preview is off; Browser Workflows009 owns generic preview sound. These linked predicates are not duplicated or expanded into all-focus/search/audio behavior here.
requirement_body_patches.REQ-KEYBOARD-NAV-016: Envelope insert marker moves horizontally on grid and shows value at location. Enter creates or selects a breakpoint at the marker; horizontal arrows move the pending point; Enter confirms. Alt/Option-left/right jumps previous/next breakpoint. Automation interpolation remains with its canonical owner. The same documented operations have supported track Arrangement automation-lane and clip Envelope Editor contexts where actually available; no every-area/every-envelope cross-product is promised. Alt-click on Windows/Option-click on Mac can move the insert marker to an existing breakpoint and select it. Exact coordinates and parameter-value math remain with automation owners.
requirement_body_patches.REQ-KEYBOARD-NAV-018: In Arrangement View, Alt/Option-up/down cycles automated device envelopes on the track. Adding Shift cycles all device parameters including ones without envelopes. Order, empty-list wrap, hidden device and selection effects remain U.
requirement_body_patches.REQ-KEYBOARD-NAV-019: The separately retained292-row shortcut catalog records documented command/binding pairs and source syntax for both platforms. It is a discovery inventory, not292 closed commands or executable tests. Per-row context, current-build applicability, command ownership and conflict resolution need reconciliation before release. Source qualifiers stay local to the rows they support. B350 enabled Computer MIDI octave/velocity use is not a prerequisite for the MIDI Map/Key Map/Computer MIDI toggles; B351 is related general single-letter-plus-Shift context, not a forced per-row modifier or global dispatch exception. Command ownership and actual target dispatch remain unreconciled.

Track/scene selection, return-slot eligibility, launch/record gates, quantization and delivered audio/timing remain with Session/launch/record/routing owners, not a new scheduler or clip codec.

new_requirements.title: Arrangement mixer, grid and locator entries
new_requirements.body: In an admitted Arrangement mixer context, Ctrl+Tab Windows/Option+Tab Mac moves between track mixers; Tab/Shift-Tab traverses the admitted track mixer controls. The source offers + and - to widen/narrow the Arrangement grid, without specifying a numeric ratio or dispatch in other focus contexts. At an admitted timeline location, Tab can reach Set Locator and Enter requests the Arrangement owner’s locator creation; Tab/Shift-Tab navigate locators and Delete requests its selected-locator deletion. Exact positions, identity, ordering, ties and grid/zoom interception remain U or Arrangement-owned.

new_requirements.body: In the source timeline context Shift plus arrows selects content; left/right moves selected content; Ctrl Windows/Cmd Mac plus X/C/V/D provides Cut/Copy/Paste/Duplicate, and Delete deletes. These are bounded input/action roles, not byte/state/clipboard, move-amount or edit/history algorithms. Applicable selection and Move Clips with Arrow Keys state must be retained.

Previous/next selected-note and same-pitch modifier differences stay U under Q052; do not infer a global shortcut precedence or selection algorithm.
